- **理论物理任务**：Anthropic Research报告Claude完成Nine Loops任务，但缓存没有正文，任务定义与计算过程仍待核实。

articles.title: Sam Altman 提议建立开放参与的 AI 标准
articles.description:
People outside the AI labs should have a real say in how this technology develops, and a clear way to judge if it's happening safely.

Standards should help prevent the concentration of power, including by making sure new companies and open-model companies can compete.

They should also help countries and companies compare evidence and learn from failures.

We think the US should lead this effort. Here is our proposal:

https://t.co/2FT9a2m4l0
articles.summary: Sam Altman 主张让 AI 实验室之外的人参与技术治理，并以标准评估发展是否安全。提议还强调防止权力过度集中、让新公司和开放模型参与竞争，并帮助国家与企业比较证据、从失败中学习。

articles.title: OpenAI 提出第三方 AI 安全评估优先事项
articles.description:
As part of our efforts to pace the frontier, we’re committed to supporting independent assessments with deep levels of access across training, evaluation, and deployment.

That access should enable third party assessors to challenge our assumptions, identify risks we may have missed, and reach their own conclusions about the effectiveness of our safeguards.

We’re outlining four priority areas for deeper assessment, alongside principles for rigorous, secure, and independent work: 

https://t.co/z2b15zsqzO
articles.summary: OpenAI 承诺支持第三方评估者深入接触训练、评测与部署环节，以便检验其假设、发现遗漏风险并独立判断安全措施效果。公司同时提出四项优先评估领域，以及开展严谨、安全和独立评估的原则。

articles.title: Kimi推出浏览器扩展，支持网页操作与技能复用
articles.description:
Meet the new Kimi Browser Extension, formerly Kimi WebBridge.

From your browser sidebar, you can chat with Kimi to navigate websites, fill out forms, and get things done.

For repetitive tasks, record your steps once and save them as a skill. Kimi can take it from there next time.

Available now on https://t.co/3u29cgYcJQ and the Chrome Web Store.
articles.summary: Kimi 将原 WebBridge 更名为浏览器扩展，用户可从浏览器侧栏与 Kimi 对话，让其浏览网站、填写表单并执行任务。用户还可录制重复操作并保存为技能，扩展现已在 Kimi 官网和 Chrome 网上应用店提供。
practice_suggestions: 从 Chrome 网上应用店安装扩展，并先用低风险网页任务验证浏览与表单操作效果。
将常见的重复网页流程录制为技能，检查步骤后再用于后续任务。
